goal: Test whether a minimal attention q/value LoRA adapter can move BGE-M3's strong dense+sparse+ColBERT fusion surface when trained with official FlagEmbedding M3 teacher-score distillation on v69 blended teacher rows.

fresh_sources_checked.implication: Keep evaluation on BGE-M3's dense+sparse+multi-vector surfaces; dense-only improvements are not enough for this model family.
The adapter smoke should use multi-function distillation rather than a dense-only objective.
The official unified M3 objective can train dense, sparse, and ColBERT behavior with teacher scores.
The v69 blended teacher rows remain compatible with the official pos_scores/neg_scores JSONL format.
A small q/value LoRA adapter is a plausible first trainable surface, but it still needs the same held-out diagnostic gate before scaling.

capabilities: Use a real torch.distributed.tensor import when available before falling back to a minimal DTensor placeholder for PEFT compatibility.
Patch the same PEFT/DTensor compatibility path before loading a full student adapter model in the BGE-M3 hybrid weight diagnostic.

training.objective: official FlagEmbedding M3 unified teacher-score distillation

diagnostic.candidate_pool: MIRACL Arabic dev fixed 200-query / top-100 same-candidate pool from v43

interpretation: The attention q/value LoRA path is now an end-to-end engineering success: train, save adapter, load adapter, and evaluate on the same fixed BGE-M3 hybrid diagnostic.
The model improved a weak sparse-heavy same-weight surface by +0.006257 nDCG@10, but it did not improve the strongest base surface; best-vs-best was -0.000787.
The model-card surface improved by +0.003129, which is directionally useful but below the required +0.005 gate.
This is not a standalone retriever success and does not justify full-dev evaluation, scaling, upload, publication, or SOTA wording.

decision.next_action: Do not scale the exact v70a recipe. The next attempt must change a larger factor such as richer train rows, a tune/held-out adapter sweep, qkv/all-linear LoRA only with explicit regularization and gates, or a stronger objective that targets the model-card/base-best surfaces directly.
